source: Exact retained one-off request and its actual unwanted learning result, harvested read-only. The live evaluator submits only inputs, never the recorded result.

content.text: Read-only acceptance check for the repaired tools and trace. No infrastructure, repository, or communication-platform changes. Create one read-only plan_goal for this check in the pinned repository; complete it with update_goal when done. Read the repository top-level README.md and /etc/os-release (public container OS metadata only, no other outside files) so the trace can distinguish project and outside paths. Call Emisar list_packs once and report whether it succeeded; if it fails, report its actual error. Keep your answer brief. Do not send Slack posts, reactions, status, files, or external actions.
